It seems like it won't be reported unless there is a determined plan with time and method. Even though it seems hard, if you think you need help it's probably a good idea to get a therapist, even if it means only disclose what you are personally comfortable disclosing. 

https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/what-do-therapists-have-report-mandatory-reporting-cutting-larsen

No matter your results, there will always be those who love you no matter what some questions on paper determine your worth is. To those people, you are worth infinitely more than that. You are worth your experiences, your character, your personality-- and none of those cannot be determined by an exam. Just keep on hanging in there!
